sections.name: PrismaService, DatabaseModule
sections.title: Database service and module
sections.what: Defines the service that connects when the app starts and disconnects when it stops, and the global module that shares it.
sections.why: Likely reason: the app should open and close the database connection with its own lifecycle.
sections.watch_out: A failed connection at startup stops the API from starting.

summary: Provides one shared database connection service for the whole API.
purpose: Lets all feature code query the database through a single managed connection.
why: Likely reason: one shared connection is simpler and avoids opening many connections.
how: 1) When the module starts, the service connects to the database. 2) When the app shuts down, it disconnects. 3) The module is global, so other modules can use the service directly.
inputs: The database connection string from the settings.
outputs: A PrismaService that other modules use to read and write data.
risks: If the database is not reachable at startup, the connection step fails and the API will not start. Because the service exposes every table, access control depends on each feature's own checks.
debug: If startup fails with a connection error, check the database connection string and whether the database is running. If a query fails, check that the Prisma client was generated.
